competition_requirements.assignment: Every provided site exactly once; one fixed composition over the evaluation period
competition_requirements.forecast_origin: Target day minus one day at17:00 Asia/Seoul
competition_requirements.peak_k: 3 when the KST timestamp end-hour is11,12,13,14,15; otherwise1

user_selected_test_protocol.model_and_composition: Frozen before the first test forecast origin; no rolling refit on test targets
user_selected_test_protocol.inner_selection: Only pre-cutoff labels; one target-day embargo
user_selected_test_protocol.missing_truth: Never fill with zero; settle only hours with every site observed
user_selected_test_protocol.fully_observed_site_cohort: Availability-based diagnostic only, never a replacement253-site settlement
user_selected_test_protocol.prior_test_exposure: This historical interval has already been inspected; results are development evidence

project_choices_not_competition_requirem.baseline: LightGBM-MAE RAW6 with the provided reference composition
project_choices_not_competition_requirem.early_stopping: Nonnegative-output capacity-weighted MAE; test S is not used for stopping
project_choices_not_competition_requirem.comparison: Mean of seed-specific scores, not an average-prediction ensemble
project_choices_not_competition_requirem.uncertainty: Seed-averaged paired daily differences; seven-day moving-block bootstrap; exploratory and unadjusted
project_choices_not_competition_requirem.custom_composition_provenance: File hash plus a user-declared fitted_through boundary; declaration is not a forensic proof
project_choices_not_competition_requirem.ranking_tie_order: Stable candidate-name display only; official tiebreak rules are not emulated

source_limits: The full authoritative problem-definition document was not present as a separate local file
The timestamp k rule follows the provided dataset README and is checked against supplied official k; conversational transcript wording is not used as a different interval rule
Official hidden-period truth, normalized leaderboard score and exact server tie handling are unavailable
